# Tabs

- **layer** molecule
- **source** —
- **status** n/a

`common/tabs` — the base tab item is 12px 15px with no gutter and an ink bar in the accent colour (`primary-color` by default, overridable per card). The `ant-tabs-pills` variant drops the ink bar for 32px-radius chips with an `#E6E6E6` border, 8px gap and 8px 12px padding; the active chip takes a primary border on `primary-light`.
